result_preview.title: Equipment Change and Service Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: Manages equipment changes, service requests, and maintenance governance.
result_preview.description: Exposes change requests, IT equipment records, and service tickets to coordinate equipment modifications and maintenance activities across the manufacturing facility. Retrieves approval workflows and risk assessments for equipment changes while managing service ticket lifecycle and equipment diagnostics integration.

result_preview.title: Procurement Order Fulfillment API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages production order status and equipment data for procurement operations.
result_preview.description: This API exposes real-time production order and equipment information to support procurement decision-making and vendor coordination. It provides access to machine availability, production order status, and fulfillment tracking data across the supply chain. The resource manages retrieval of asset and order details to streamline sourcing and purchase order workflows.

result_preview.title: Incident Root Cause Analysis Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously analyzes service tickets to identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically processes high-priority service tickets to perform root cause analysis by correlating incident patterns, examining related IT equipment status, and linking to historical change requests. It generates diagnostic reports and suggests preventive measures to reduce ticket recurrence, enabling faster resolution and improved service quality.
